summary: Ryanair Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing weekly share buyback transactions under its existing programme announced on 20 May 2025. Between 10-14 August 2026, the company repurchased 193,778 ordinary shares at a volume-weighted average price of €24.83 and 82,290 ordinary shares underlying ADSs at US$29.81 per ADS, all for cancellation. These are open-market purchases executed under EU Market Abuse Regulation Article 5(1)(b) notification requirements. The buyback is ongoing with weekly disclosures. What to watch: pace of future purchases and potential impact on share count as the programme progresses.
